assertionResults.title: Legacy manage-booking routes canonicalize to one booking detail route
assertionResults.visibleResult: Guest sign-in page shown with preserved legacy query state nested inside redirectedFrom.

evidence.network: No requests captured by agent-browser for this navigation; final URL preserved query continuity in redirectedFrom.

assertionResults.title: Legacy booking thank-you routes canonicalize to guest receipt
assertionResults.visibleResult: Legacy thank-you route normalized through guest receipt and then to guest sign-in with receipt query preserved.

assertionResults.title: Restaurant thank-you aliases canonicalize to one public confirmation route
assertionResults.visibleResult: Route remained on the restaurant thank-you alias instead of demonstrating canonical normalization.
assertionResults.issues: No canonical redirect was observed from the restaurant-scoped alias on the live local surface.

assertionResults.title: Guest routes opened on the app host canonicalize back to the guest host
assertionResults.visibleResult: App-host guest route stayed on app.localhost and rendered operations sign-in instead of canonicalizing to the guest host.
assertionResults.issues: Local runtime still redirected to app-host operations sign-in rather than back to the root guest host.

evidence.network: Final URL and visible result captured; no cross-host canonical redirect observed.

assertionResults.title: Public booking detail requires authenticated or recovered access
assertionResults.visibleResult: Unauthenticated booking detail redirected cleanly to guest sign-in.
assertionResults.issues: Authorized detail case could not be reached from the assigned live/public surface without mutating shared auth state.

evidence.network: Redirect target preserved recovery wrapper for /bookings/booking-1.

assertionResults.title: Booking detail loading, empty, and error states are explicit
assertionResults.visibleResult: Only unauthenticated sign-in redirect was reachable.
assertionResults.issues: No entitled booking-detail loading/error fixture was exposed on the live browser surface or dev harness.

assertionResults.title: Booking detail presents clear lifecycle status and next actions
assertionResults.visibleResult: No entitled booking detail content was visible.
assertionResults.issues: No reachable authorized booking-detail fixture to inspect lifecycle status or actions.

assertionResults.title: Booking detail disables management actions when lifecycle rules disallow them
assertionResults.visibleResult: Non-manageable entitled booking state was not reachable.
assertionResults.issues: Could not reach a cancelled/locked/past booking detail state within the isolation boundary.

assertionResults.title: Non-manageable booking states explain how the guest can regain control
assertionResults.visibleResult: No non-manageable guidance state was reachable.
assertionResults.issues: Assigned live/public routes did not expose an entitled non-manageable booking detail fixture.

assertionResults.title: Rebook sends guests back into a canonical booking-entry flow
assertionResults.visibleResult: No rebook CTA was reachable because entitled detail never rendered.
assertionResults.issues: Could not reach an authorized booking detail containing a rebook action.

assertionResults.title: Guest receipt requires authenticated or token-based entitlement
assertionResults.visibleResult: Receipt route rendered but the live surface did not provide a deterministic way to confirm whether the token granted entitlement versus a fallback/error path.
assertionResults.issues: No known valid receipt token or authenticated guest fixture was provided, so the success entitlement case could not be conclusively validated.

evidence.network: Direct load of /guest/bookings/booking-1/receipt?token=valid-token without a documented valid token fixture.

assertionResults.title: Guest receipt summarizes the reservation in a confirmation-oriented format
assertionResults.visibleResult: A conclusive entitled receipt confirmation view was not available for inspection.
assertionResults.issues: Without a confirmed entitled receipt fixture, confirmation-oriented content could not be verified reliably.

evidence.network: Same direct receipt load as VAL-BOOKING-009.

assertionResults.title: Receipt messaging changes appropriately for active, pending, and cancelled bookings
assertionResults.visibleResult: Lifecycle-specific receipt variants were not available.
assertionResults.issues: No active/pending/cancelled receipt fixtures were exposed in the assigned isolation boundary.

evidence.network: Same direct receipt load as VAL-BOOKING-009.

assertionResults.title: Recovery success strips the token from the final destination URL
assertionResults.visibleResult: Clicking the recovery harness link returned to the same harness page rather than landing on a final entitled booking destination.
assertionResults.issues: The documented recovery harness did not produce a stable successful final destination with token stripped from the browser URL.

assertionResults.title: Recovery flow preserves destination continuity end to end
assertionResults.visibleResult: Recovery harness did not complete into an entitled internal booking surface, so end-to-end continuity failed on the live surface.
assertionResults.issues: Live recovery chain bounced into sign-in instead of preserving continuity to the intended internal booking destination.

evidence.network: Same recovery redirect chain as VAL-BOOKING-013.

frictions.description: agent-browser get text body returned streamed Next.js payload text before visible content, so visible results were inferred primarily from final URLs and screenshots.
frictions.resolution: Used screenshots plus final URLs as primary evidence and treated body-text output as secondary.

blockers.description: No deterministic authorized booking-detail or receipt fixture was exposed on the allowed live/public surface without mutating shared auth state.
blockers.quickFixAttempted: Used /dev/booking-recovery and direct tokenized receipt URLs, but neither supplied a reliable entitled success fixture.

summary: Validated 14 assigned assertions on the live browser surface: 2 passed, 3 failed, and 9 were blocked by missing entitled fixtures or incomplete live recovery behavior.
